objective: Measure whether the agentic environment improves production solution quality on an open-solution, multi-risk repository task, and quantify its time and resource overhead.

resource_outcomes.reported_cost_usd: provider-reported only; may differ from subscription charge
resource_outcomes.subscription_charge: not observable unless the provider exposes it

analysis.pairing: same provider, explicit model, effort, task, trial seed, limits and clean workspace across arms
analysis.win_rule: A quality win requires at least 8 median points or a passed critical floor that the other arm misses. Time or tokens break ties only when quality differs by at most 5 points and critical outcomes are equivalent.
analysis.never_collapse: Always report absolute quality and every dimension beside time, tokens and cost. Do not hide a security or generalization failure inside one efficiency number.
analysis.descriptive_uncertainty: Report paired differences and medians at three trials; bootstrap intervals and stronger claims require at least five trials per arm.

stop_rules: Stop if both arms score 100 in every pair: ceiling.
Stop if every paired quality difference is within 3 points and no critical check differs: no actionable signal.
Stop and inspect if any run is infrastructure-invalid; replacements need separate approval.

stages.entry: Only after complex-screen shows at least an 8-point paired quality signal or a critical-dimension difference and receives separate human approval.
Only after a confirmed Codex effect and separate human approval.
